settlementMerit.rationale: Dunino has two worthwhile integrated visitor points—the Den and the regularly accessible church—plus a community walk resource and modest arrival parking. With no café, public toilet or verified picnic provision, it remains a compact attraction cluster rather than a rounded 60+ town experience.
